sql: select o.market_ticker, to_char(min(f.filled_at) filter (where o.action='buy'),'MM-DD HH24:MI') first_buy, sum(f.quantity) filter (where o.action='buy') bq, round(sum(f.price*f.quantity) filter (where o.action='buy')/100.0,2) cost, sum(f.quantity) filter (where o.action='sell') sq, round(sum((100-f.price)*f.quantity) filter (where o.action='sell')/100.0,2) proceeds, string_agg(distinct left(coalesce(o.client_order_id,''),9),',') kinds from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Alimm1' and f.filled_at > '2026-10-12' group by 1 order by 2
